level_scale.L0: advice and templates only - no system access, no business data read
level_scale.L1: reads one connected source and summarises it
level_scale.L2: reads several sources and produces analysis or a document
level_scale.L3: acts inside one system behind an approval gate - drafts, prepares, recommends; a human executes
level_scale.L4: owns a recurring cadence end to end - schedules, enforces, escalates, reports its own performance

schema_note: Employees carrying schema 2 also declare level, category, permissions, cost, connector availability, status probation and reliability unverified. Earlier entries keep the v1 shape until a backfill drop.
